Use when: an agent needs a broad market briefing before token research. Core inputs: none. Limits: research context only; incomplete lanes are marked partial or unavailable.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {}, "additionalProperties": false}}, {"name": "scan_market", "description": "Delivery: a ranked candidate set with price, momentum, market-activity evidence, filters, and reasons where available. Use when: an agent needs a shortlist before deeper token analysis. Core inputs: optional chain, theme, and top_n. Limits: theme is contextual rather than a strict filter; a scan is not a trade instruction.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"chain": {"type": "string", "description": "Chain slug e.g. eth/bsc (optional)."}, "theme": {"type": "string", "description": "Narrative/theme filter (optional)."}, "top_n": {"type": "number", "description": "How many candidates to return."}, "filter_direction": {"type": "string", "description": "Direction filter: 'positive' (gainers only), 'negative' (losers only), or 'all' (default)."}}, "additionalProperties": false}}, {"name": "analyze_token", "description": "Delivery: a single-token research pack with USD market data, multi-window performance, calculated RSI and ATR, intelligence, summary, and warnings. Use when: an agent needs a quick structured token read. Core input: symbol. Limits: missing measurements are reported as unavailable and the result is not execution advice.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"symbol": {"type": "string", "description": "Token symbol, e.g. INJ."}, "chain": {"type": "string", "description": "Chain slug for contract-specific safety, e.g. eth/bsc (optional)."}}, "required": ["symbol"], "additionalProperties": false}}, {"name": "deep_analysis", "description": "Delivery: a deeper token evidence pack combining market context, confluence, technicals, an optional Skill Hub token profile, derivatives, catalysts, risks, and a measured-ATR preview plan. Use when: an agent needs one comprehensive token read. Core input: token symbol; optional include_perp. Limits: token analysis only, not wallet analysis; unavailable lanes remain explicit and no trade is placed.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"symbol": {"type": "string", "description": "Token symbol, e.g. SOL."}, "chain": {"type": "string", "description": "Chain slug for contract-specific safety (optional)."}, "include_perp": {"type": "boolean", "description": "Include derivatives/perp posture (default true)."}}, "required": ["symbol"], "additionalProperties": false}}, {"name": "compare_tokens", "description": "Delivery: a side-by-side comparison of two to four tokens with factor winners, coverage by token, an overall pick, rationale, confidence, and conclusion method. Use when: an agent must compare relative momentum, market activity, and volatility using common data. Core inputs: symbols; optional intent. Limits: missing factors are disclosed and deterministic conclusions are labelled.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"symbols": {"type": "string", "description": "2-4 token symbols to compare, comma- or space-separated, e.g. 'SOL, AVAX'."}, "intent": {"type": "string", "description": "Trade horizon the pick is for: swing | hold | spot (optional).", "enum": ["swing", "hold", "spot"]}}, "required": ["symbols"], "additionalProperties": false}}, {"name": "monitor_market_sentiment_shift", "description": "Delivery: a seven-day market sentiment evidence pack containing Fear & Greed level and change, BTC perpetual funding crowding, BTC liquidation pressure and side, altseason phase, the combined regime, observation dates, coverage scope, and full measurements. Use when: an agent needs to check whether market sentiment materially shifted. Core inputs: optional time_window fixed to 7d. Limits: market-wide context except for BTC-referenced derivatives; no causality claim or advice.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"time_window": {"type": "string", "enum": ["7d"], "default": "7d", "description": "Sentiment comparison window; currently fixed to seven days."}}, "additionalProperties": false}}]}}
